name: Qwen3.8-27B Heretic, uncensored (NVFP4 W4A16)
notes: Abliterated (Heretic) Qwen3.8-27B: dense, hybrid linear/full attention, refusals removed. ModelOpt NVFP4 weights with 16-bit activations (W4A16), which vLLM runs with the FP4 Marlin kernel. Uses the same official vLLM image as MiMo (vLLM 0.29.1, multi-node without Ray); support for the quantization, the architecture and the parsers was checked in that image, but the model has not been run here yet. The vision tower is skipped with --language-model-only. 20.6 GB of weights leaves most of the memory for KV cache, so a lower GPU memory share is enough. Thinking is on by default.
